appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'
The pie chart is divided into four colored segments.
Segment labeled 'Fossil Fuels (50%)' is colored dark red and occupies 50% of the pie chart.
Segment labeled 'Nuclear (15%)' is colored orange and occupies 15% of the pie chart.
Segment labeled 'Renewables (25%)' is colored reddish-orange and occupies 25% of the pie chart.
Segment labeled 'Hydroelectric (10%)' is colored pale yellow and occupies 10% of the pie chart.

public_definitions: Use the dashboard to determine which energy source is the largest category in global energy consumption for this routing decision.
Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring
